original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical CUDA.jl only writes a one-element marker and prints hardcoded wordcount/PASS/time lines without processing text. Preserve those bytes; new reference computes actual source byte-run counts. Native is_word_start/is_alpha functors are unchanged; named adapter retains same Thrust inner_product expression on borrowed preallocated input, excluding original CLI allocation/H2D/free for every model.
original_reference_provenance.source_predicate_policy: ASCII byte interval65..122 includes six punctuation bytes91..96. Explicit source policy preserved, not linguistic alphabetical word semantics.
original_reference_provenance.ROI_adaptation: Original source word_count allocates/copies/frees device_vector percall. Named preallocated operator excludes input allocation/copy/free all4; temporary/reset/reduction/scalarcompletion remain timed. Original fullCLI ROI unmeasured.

model_windows.shared_reference_preparation: Smoke-reference audit/repair, native operator adapter, independent source-policy witness and verification.
model_windows.ka: KA kernel drafting/verification, native compiler/header-version lookup while queued.
model_windows.jacc: JACC drafting/verification plus same-benchmark scientific and ontology metadata preparation.

usage_scope_review.counter_policy: Raw counters preserved; parent workflow overlaps children, do not sum.
